_comment: Copy to config.json (kit root or host/) and edit; config.json is git-ignored. Every key is optional; command-line flags win. profile: pinball (PinUP Popper), arcade (Batocera, RetroBat, RetroPie, ES-DE) or rcade (R-Cade / GRS Build-A-Cade FU: arcade cards + cards/_keypad_rcade.json + virtual gamepad). cabinet/subtitle override the idle file. idle_config/keypad_config/default_card: file names in cards/ (or paths). port: COM5, /dev/ttyUSB0 or a list; omit to auto-detect. watch_processes: programs that open the keypad while running (omit to use the keypad file's list, [] for none). key_backend: auto | sendinput | evdev | uinput | dry-run. key_hold_ms: how long keypad keys are held (default 40). virtual_gamepad: true adds the Linux virtual gamepad 'cyd-pad' for keypad keys named pad:... (default false; true in the rcade profile). displays: board id (from --list-displays; port:COM5 for firmware 1.2.0 boards) -> name / role / rotation / keypad / idle_config; host values win over the identity saved on the board. keypad_roles: only these displays show the keypad and send keys (omit = all). exclude_ports: never open these (other devices with a CH340/CP210x). Tested with 5 displays; there is no hard limit (max_displays caps it if you want). Content roles (one job per board): control_panel, howtoplay, picture, pictureboxart, videoofplay, gallery (box art, gameplay, video still in turn), keyboard. A board with one of these is sent only the matching card or idle screen. keyboard gets the keypad only when the content includes a keypad card. Other roles (left, right, top, ...) are unchanged.
